request.description: Creates a new interview record with family and guardian information. This endpoint creates both the family and the guardian family member in a single transaction. The guardian is automatically marked as the family guardian. Example usage: Submit a new family interview application with complete family and guardian details.

item.name: Visits

request.description: Creates a new visit record for a family. This endpoint requires CREATE_VISIT permission. The request body contains comprehensive information about the family visit including household items, income details, and committee evaluation.

query.description: Filter by Baraka association income amount
Search in notes and committee suggestions (max:1000)

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of visits with comprehensive filtering options. This endpoint requires READ_VISIT permission. Results are ordered by visit date descending (most recent first). All query parameters are optional and can be combined for advanced filtering.
Retrieves a specific visit by its ID. This endpoint requires READ_VISIT permission. The response includes the visit details with family relationship loaded.

Updates an existing visit record. This endpoint requires UPDATE_VISIT permission. The familyId field is excluded from updates as it cannot be changed after creation. All other fields are optional and can be updated individually or in combination.
Deletes a visit record by its ID. This endpoint requires DELETE_VISIT permission. Returns HTTP 204 No Content on successful deletion. The visit will be permanently removed from the database.
